title: The Great Train Robbery (1903)
description: Classic American silent Western film directed by Edwin S. Porter. Public Domain according to the Wikimedia Commons source page.

title: The Squaw Man (1914)
description: American silent Western drama directed by Cecil B. DeMille and Oscar C. Apfel. Public Domain according to the Wikimedia Commons source page.

title: The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari (1920)
description: German silent horror film directed by Robert Wiene. The Wikimedia Commons video page identifies the work as Public Domain.

title: The Gold Rush (1925)
description: Silent comedy film written, directed and starring Charlie Chaplin. The Wikimedia Commons source identifies this 1925 work as Public Domain in the United States; copyright status can vary by jurisdiction.
